company.name: Choco Communications, GmbH.
company.shortDescription: Choco is a food ordering platform that connects restaurants and suppliers.
company.description: Choco develops an ingredient ordering application designed to connect restaurants and suppliers. Their application offers an interface reminiscent of popular consumer apps, with a messenger-like chat interface for communication between suppliers and restaurants and a post-mates-like ordering list that makes ordering easy, enabling restaurants to get their food delivery application for getting ingredients from suppliers.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered order-processing tool that captures orders from voicemail, email, fax, SMS, WhatsApp, and handwritten notes, then transfers them into a distributor’s ERP system.

productsAndServices.description: A sales-management tool for food distributors that helps representatives prioritize accounts, understand buying behavior, and identify actions to increase revenue.
productsAndServices.name: SalesHub

productsAndServices.description: Integration and implementation services that connect Choco’s ordering and sales products with distributors’ existing ERP and warehouse-management systems.
